200.description:
The official scope description of a license's classification (Aura action ARCP_ContractorSearch.getLicenseDescriptionDetail, the detail page's 'License Classification Description' panel): for the license's classification, the license type (e.g. 'Specialty Commercial'), the classification (e.g. 'C-37 Plumbing') and the Registrar's description of the work it covers, as plain text (paragraph breaks preserved) and as the site's HTML. Keyed by the Salesforce `license_id` from search_contractors. An unknown license_id is not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

classifications.description:
C-37 PLUMBING

Installation, alteration, and repair of all plumbing when performed solely within property lines and not on public easements or right-of-ways, except as hereinafter provided.

Installation, alteration, and repair of all piping, fixtures, and appliances related to water supply, including pressure vessels and tanks (excluding municipal or related water supply systems); venting and sanitary drainage systems for all fluid, semi-fluid, and organic wastes; septic tanks and leaching lines; roof leaders; lawn sprinklers; water conditioning equipment; piping; and equipment for swimming pools.

Also included are piping, fixtures, appliances, and pressure vessels for manufactured and natural gases, compressed air and vacuum systems, petroleum, fuel oil, non-potable liquids, hot water heating, and hot water supply systems operating at pressures not exceeding 30 PSIG, or temperatures not exceeding 220?é?? F; steam heating and steam supply systems not exceeding 15 PSIG operating pressure; gas or oil fired space heaters and furnaces, excluding duct work. Piping for water cooling systems, excluding the refrigerant piping and equipment. Testing and balancing of hydronics systems.

Sewer, gas, water lines, and connections from structure to the nearest point of public supply or disposal may cross public or private easements or be installed within private easements or right-of-ways. Pipe installed across public property may not be increased in size, or make any other connection between the point of exit from private property to the point of connection at public supply or disposal. These lines shall not be installed parallel to main lines in public easements or right-of-ways.

200.description:
One ROC license record (Aura actions ARCP_ContractorSearch.getLicenseDetail + getAllPersonnelDetail + getAllBondDetail + getAllComplaintsDetail, sent as one batch; the site's contractor detail page). Keyed by the Salesforce `license_id` from search_contractors (a pasted detail URL `.../contractor-search?licenseId=...` is accepted). Returns the license (ROC number, status and status-change date, issue date, renewal-through date, classification description, entity type, QP exemption, business and DBA names, city/state/ZIP, phone), the personnel on file (name, title, other positions), the surety bonds (number, type, status, effective and cancellation dates, bond, allotted, available, payout and repayment amounts in USD, surety company) and the public complaint summary (open, resolved and disciplined counts) with each complaint's number, status, nature, type, allegations, outcome, closed date and jobsite city. Complainant identities are not returned. An unknown license_id makes the site answer an Apex System.QueryException; that is reported as not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `address` | string | 'City, AZ, ZIP' with the site's HTML wrapper removed. |
| `bonds` | object[] |  |
| `business_name` | string |  |
| `classification_description` | string | License type and classification, e.g. 'Specialty Commercial C-37 Plumbing'. |
| `complaints` | object |  |
| `dba_name` | string |  |
| `entity_type` | string |  |
| `issued_date` | string |  |
| `license_id` | string |  |
| `license_number` | string | e.g. 'ROC 084810' |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |

| `phone` | string |  |
| `qp_exempt` | boolean |  |
| `renewal_through` | string | Date the current renewal runs through (the site's renewalThr). |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `status` | string |  |
| `status_changed_date` | string | ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) as the site sends it. |

200.description:
Search the Arizona ROC contractor register (Aura action ARCP_ContractorSearch.getRecords, the site's 'Contractor Search'). `query` matches a business name, a person's name ('First Last'), or a ROC license number (6 digits, with or without the 'ROC ' prefix); `classifications` filters by license classification exactly as `list_classifications` spells them (e.g. 'C-42 Roofing'; the site matches the classification family loosely, a 'C-42 Roofing' filter also returns 'CR-42 Roofing' licenses); `city` filters by the licensee's Arizona city. At least one criterion is required. Results are grouped the way the site shows them: one row per business/account with its contacts (name and role) and every license it holds (license_id, ROC license number, status such as Active / Suspended / Revoked / Expired, classification, qualifying party or QP-exempt). The server returns the whole result set in one answer (a broad single-word query can be several hundred accounts and take a few seconds); this function pages through it client-side with `page_size` rows per page and an offset `cursor`, re-running the same search for each page. A search that matches nothing is a valid empty result (`accounts: []`).

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `accounts` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string | Salesforce Account id of the business (001...). |
| `address` | string | 'City, AZ, ZIP' as shown; the register does not publish street addresses. |
| `contacts` | object[] |  |
| `dba_name` | string | 'Doing business as' label exactly as the site shows it (e.g. 'DBA : 928 Roofing'); null when the site sends none. |
| `licenses` | object[] |  |
| `name` | string |  |
| `phone` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
